Class CollisionChecker

  • Method Details

    • checkTileCollision

      public void checkTileCollision(Character character)
      Checks the neighboring tiles for collsion. Firstly, the method calculates the character's neighboring cooridnates. Then, the method takes the character's direction and checks whether or not the next tile has collision. If true, blocks player movement
      Parameters:
      character - the player character

    • checkEntityCollision

      public void checkEntityCollision(Character player, Entity entity)
      Checks collisions with solid entity. Firstly, the method calculates the character's future occupied area. Then, it creates a rectangle based on the data. The method applies the same process to an entity. If the two rectangles intersect, block palyer movement.*
      Parameters:
      player - the player character
      entity - any other entity

    • findInteractable

      public Entity findInteractable(Character player)
      Checks if there is an interactable entity in the vicinity of the player, depending on the direction they're facing. The stream API is used to filter the entities and find the one to interact with at the end.
      Parameters:
      player - the player
      Returns:
      the entity to interact with, null if none is present.
